subtitle: Beer Basics — Everything About the World's Favorite Stout

lessons.title: The Story of Guinness
bullets: Founded by Arthur Guinness in Dublin, 1759
He signed a legendary 9,000-year lease on St. James's Gate
Now brewed in over 49 countries worldwide

lessons.title: What Makes It a Stout
bullets: A dry Irish stout — roasted, not sweet
Roasted barley gives it that coffee-like bitterness
Deep ruby-black color, not truly black

lessons.title: How It's Brewed
bullets: Malted barley, roasted barley, hops, water, yeast
Unmalted roasted barley gives the signature flavor

lessons.title: The Nitro Pour & The Widget
bullets: Nitrogen + CO2 blend creates the famously creamy head
The perfect pour takes 119.5 seconds, done in two parts

lessons.title: Tasting & Serving
bullets: Serve cold (around 6°C) in a tulip pint glass
Notes: coffee, dark chocolate, a clean bitter finish
Lower ABV (~4.2%) than most people expect
